title: Assemble four teasers and truthful N

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Result assembly tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_result_assembly.py

evidence_required: FT-004-AC-003 RED: no promo-owned candidate union or teaser assembler exists; GREEN: repeated-Photo, weak-match-exclusion and diversity-tie fixtures produce exactly four unique threshold-valid teaser IDs, keep them inside the complete unique processed-detection union and set N to that union cardinality, while fewer than four returns insufficient_results; decisive comparison: deterministic assembly artifact versus fixture truth; artifact: focused pytest under .tasks/TASK-071-T2-FT-004-W3/.
purpose: Implement the promo-owned deterministic candidate-pool algorithm without mixing search admission, persistence or display behavior into the assembly function.
success_outcome: Given complete processing match observations, promo returns either four unique threshold-valid teasers plus the complete union and truthful N, or explicit insufficient_results.
anti_goals: Do not query Photo/search stores, persist sessions or construct HTTP responses.
Do not use pHash as a match gate or guarantee complete group-member coverage.
Do not add tracking, identity clustering, replacement selection or N truncation.

forbidden_scope: Promo session migrations, QR ticket secrets and Attempt transitions
stop_conditions: Assembly requires missing product behavior beyond the canonical algorithm.
Four unique threshold-valid Photos cannot remain a subset of the complete union.
A deterministic tie cannot be resolved by the accepted similarity/photo_id order.

constraints: Consume the ordered typed match sets published by processing and retain selected-detection order.
Use pure deterministic fixtures; proof data is task-owned and needs no persistent runtime state.
Keep final farthest-first and fallback rules exactly within the canonical Result Assembly section.
invariants: One Photo matching several detections contributes to the union and N once.
Fewer than four unique valid Photos cannot produce a partial result.
verification_targets: FT-004-AC-003 candidate fixtures reconcile teaser uniqueness/subset and N with the full union.
Insufficient, repeated and deterministic-tie fixtures prove the explicit non-success boundary.
